notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
description:
Activate Necrogenesis by paying {2}, exling a creature card from an opponent's graveyard and creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card from an opponent's exile into their graveyard, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion, adding {C}{C}.
The Eldrazi Scion dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
